newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P withdraws ratings for Orebro Energi.
newsitem.headline: S&P withdraws ratings for Orebro Energi.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's (S&P) said on Monday it was withdrawing Orebro Energi AB's ratings.
This was at the company's request after it was acquired by Swedish power group Sydkraft.
S&P said this meant that Orebro Energi's borrowing will be coordinated with the total funding of the Sydkraft group.
Orebro Energi did have a K-1 short-term commercial paper rating and an A long-term corporate credit rating.
"There will be no rate public debt outstanding when the last securities issued under Orebro Energi's domestic commerical paper programme are repaid on March 18, 1997," S&P said in a statement.
Orebro Energi's ratings were placed on credit watch with positive implications after Sydkraft's takeover bid on December 17 last year.
Sydkraft's acquisition of Orebro Energi has now been approved by Sydkraft's board, the City Council of Orebro and the Swedish Competition Authority.

Sydkraft's AA- long-term and A-1+ short-term ratings have been on credit watch with negative implications since Januaary 15 awaiting the outcome of a government move to close one reactor at the Barseback nuclear power station next year.
